evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:11-29 uses a single local SQLite file and only creates the orders table; there is no backup, WAL tuning, migration layer, or recovery path.
impact: Order data durability depends entirely on one local file path; corruption, accidental deletion, or wrong working directory loses or fragments data.
mitigation: Pin an explicit absolute database path in deployment, add backup/restore guidance, and introduce migration and durability settings before production use.

evidence: minisvc/audit.py:4-10 builds transient dicts only, and minisvc/storage/repo.py:11-29 persists only the orders table.
impact: Operational or compliance consumers can assume an audit trail exists when reads and writes leave no durable audit record.
mitigation: Either persist audit rows transactionally with order writes or remove/clarify audit claims in operator-facing docs.

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-14 parses MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY, but minisvc/cli.py:7-12 and minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22 never enforce readonly; default DB path is the relative file orders.sqlite.
impact: Readonly mode is ineffective, and process working directory silently changes where data is stored.
mitigation: Enforce readonly in the write path, validate startup configuration, and prefer an explicit deployment path over the relative default.

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:6-13 indexes payload keys directly and coerces total_cents with int(); no handler catches KeyError, ValueError, or sqlite3.IntegrityError from minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22.
impact: Malformed requests and duplicate IDs surface as raw exceptions instead of stable client-facing errors.
mitigation: Add explicit request validation, duplicate-order handling, and response mapping around repository failures.

evidence: minisvc/api/routes.py:4-6 assumes app.post/app.get methods and passes lambda wrappers, but the repository contains no concrete app implementation or interface contract.
impact: Integrators can wire the service incorrectly because the expected app API, payload shape, and error mapping are implicit.
mitigation: Document the adapter contract or add a thin reference app/server that exercises register_routes end to end.
